antiModelSoupRules: A playable site selects one planet material grammar, one resident-faction silhouette binding, one location-class kit, and one authored damage or infestation state. Do not draw unrelated hero assets from multiple planet packs.

Generate isolated interoperable modules, never a complete random Hunyuan city diorama. Every module must declare scale, pivot, footprint, socket faces, clearances, material regions, collision intent, and LOD role before generation.
Complete transit topology before adding landmarks: straight, corner, T, X/plaza, endcap/adapter, local road, service lane, pedestrian concourse, and wall gate.
A palette swap is not a faction or planet variant. Geometry rhythm, silhouette, access logic, damage language, material response, decals, and terrain contact must differ where lore says they differ.

Use a 70/20/10 composition target: approximately 70% repeatable infrastructure and low/mid modules, 20% identity buildings and utilities, and no more than 10% unique hero landmarks in a typical district.
World-detail assets attach only to authored service, utility, curb, roof, or plot sockets. Do not scatter props randomly into navigation, turning, landing, objective, or shot-clearance volumes.
Road and concourse socket planes remain flat, identical, and obstruction-free. Curbs, lights, rails, pipes, decals, debris, and vegetation stop before the socket plane.
Brood is a non-playable, non-humanoid hostile ecology. Brood architecture must read as functional living infrastructure rather than a creature, face, tentacle pile, or recolored resident building.

Pressure domes, hangars, gates, and gantries must preserve their declared traversable portals in source geometry, LODs, and compound collision. A closed generated aperture is a reclassification or rejection, not a visual pass.
Raw Spline exports, cleaned sources, processing mirrors, LODs, collision, and damage variants are lifecycle forms of one canonical asset and must not be counted as separate library members.
Do not promote single-material Hunyuan meshes directly. Split semantic structural, facade, roof, contact, glazing, emissive, damage, and infestation regions before runtime admission.
Every completed pack needs a deterministic assembly example at phone RTS camera scale, including at least one intact, damaged, and infested/disabled composition where applicable.

completionVerdict.reason: The repository contains valuable source candidates, concepts, and contracts, but most requested families are still prompts or planned definitions. No Hunyuan ledger asset is runtime-ready; roads and interoperable connectors are absent; Dominion and accepted Brood architecture coverage are zero; 90 interior members have no geometry; and 29 of 32 first-wave planet jobs remain concept-blocked.
completionVerdict.nextAction: Generate the ranked transit topology first, then validate deterministic assemblies before adding more hero buildings. Keep every generated output source-only until semantic materials, sockets, collision/navigation, LODs, damage states, mobile captures, and package/performance gates pass.
